dishes.name: Regensburger Wurst
dishes.desc: Coarse smoked pork sausage, short and thick, eaten hot with mustard or in a roll. Regensburg's own recipe.

dishes.name: Upper Palatinate carp
dishes.desc: Carp from the pond country of the Upper Palatinate, served baked or fried in autumn and winter.

dishes.name: Dampfnudel
dishes.desc: Yeast dumpling steamed in a covered pan so it gets a salty, caramelised crust underneath, served with vanilla sauce. A classic of Upper Palatinate and Lower Bavarian kitchens.

dishes.name: Oberpfälzer Bauernseufzer
dishes.desc: Air-dried, smoked salami-style sausage from the Upper Palatinate, eaten as a snack with bread.
